lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 요즘 글쓰기 성과가 좋다면서요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, I hear your writing is going well these days?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, yojeum geulsseugi seonggwaga jotamyeonseoyo?
lines.en: Yes, a piece I submitted got published in a magazine.
I wrote about our last outing and camping trip.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, we rode the swings then too. It was fun.
lines.learner: 네, 그네 타던 장면으로 글을 시작했어요.
lines.en: Yes, I started the piece with the swing scene.
lines.roman: Ne, geune tadeon jangmyeoneuro geureul sijakaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you also plan to publish it as a book?
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to publish an essay collection next year.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, have you decided on the cover?
lines.learner: 아직이요. 표지는 친구가 그려 주기로 했어요.
lines.en: Not yet. A friend is going to draw the cover.
lines.roman: Ajigiyo. Pyojineun chinguga geuryeo jugiro haesseoyo.

lines.learner: 매주 글을 올렸더니 독자가 많이 늘었어요.
lines.en: I posted every week, and my readers grew a lot.
lines.roman: Maeju geureul ollyeotdeoni dokjaga mani neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Amazing. The literary world must be interested too.
lines.en: I want to debut as an official writer.

lines.beaver_en: It might even become a bestseller.
lines.en: Actually, I made a bet with a friend about that.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, not gambling, right? What did you bet?
lines.learner: 아니에요, 그냥 밥 한 끼 걸었어요.
lines.en: No, we just bet a meal.
lines.roman: Anieyo, geunyang bap han kki georeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Let's have a celebration party at the next meeting.
lines.en: Sounds good. By writing, my life has become more joyful.
